name: Corporate secretarial and entity records (kept for another legal person)
one_line: The apparatus by which a practitioner, a company-secretarial provider or an in-house team KEEPS THE CONSTITUTIONAL RECORD OF A REGISTERED LEGAL PERSON on that person's behalf: the statutory register book, the incorporation and formation packet, the drafted-but-unadopted resolution and minute, the group structure and entity inventory, the annual compliance calendar, the entity-management-system export, and the corporate-record handover on closure. Its anchor is an ENTITY REGISTRATION NUMBER repeated across artefacts, plus one artefact carrying a matter, engagement or service reference - a substitution for the `law_practice` schema default's two-role leg, which does not fire on this family's characteristic file because a register names DIRECTORS AND MEMBERS, not a practitioner and a client. It deliberately does NOT hold the entity's own board cycle held by the entity itself (`business_operations.board-governance`), its compelled submissions to an authority (`business_operations.corporate-regulatory-filings`; `law_practice.regulatory-submission` on the practitioner side), executed constitutional instruments and share certificates (`legal`, whose safety protection runs first), or the equity economics of one entity's holders (`finance.cap-table-equity`). Absorbs the legacy corporate-secretarial/company-records coverage. Placeholder row researched to J-DEPTH: it recognises the situation and writes NO field rows, because the `law_practice` schema declares none (D1 as narrowed, PR-6).

proposed_fields.rule_family: registry-identifier-plus-context: an entity-registration-number-shaped token confirmed by a co-located entity-suffix token and a constitutional context term (register, incorporation, resolution, articles, registered office). Not a regex here - R2 owns the pattern, R4 owns any gazetteer.
proposed_fields.why: This family's grouping axis is a REGISTERED LEGAL PERSON, which is not any existing key. `client` is a role in a representation and the entity here is routinely NOT the client: a corporate group hands one engagement fifty subsidiaries, most of them dormant, none of them separately instructing. `organization` (already proposed elsewhere on the roster) is the collector sense that 00's own template validator strikes - it rejects a template that would "use an author or organization merely as a collector" - and a corporate-secretarial folder branched on `organization` would be exactly that for the parent while losing the subsidiary distinction that is the entire point. `institution` is the academic key. RECOMMENDATION TO R1c: if a fifth key is refused, the honest fallback is `organization` carrying an entity value plus a note that subsidiaries and their parent collapse; do not mint a second entity synonym.

proposed_fields.rule_family: linkage only; promotion to validated requires a labelled slot (a form field reading company number / registration number / entity id), per 00's direct path "such as a content hash, EXIF timestamp, a document title, or a labeled form field".
proposed_fields.why: SEARCH AND JOIN ONLY, and it is proposed precisely so that it can be forbidden as a folder level in the same breath. It is the one exact token that joins a register page, a formation packet, a compliance-calendar row and an entity-inventory row whose filenames share nothing; without it the family has no anchor and 00's stop rule bites - "It should not form a supported group when there is no valid anchor". But a folder named for eight digits is unintelligible, and a registration number is a stable public handle that makes a filesystem path externally resolvable to a named legal person, against "The default posture must therefore be local-first and data-minimizing." No existing key holds a registry identifier: `account_type` is a finance shape, `record_type` is a document-function enum.

deterministic: PRECONDITION - THE SCHEMA'S SUBSTITUTION, AND IT IS THIS TEMPLATE'S FIRST REASON TO EXIST. These are activation signals only; no `law_practice` fact may be written, because the schema declares no field rows. The `law_practice` default requires BOTH of two legs: (i) an exact matter, file or engagement reference repeated across two or more artefacts, and (ii) at least one artefact whose own labelled slots separate a PRACTITIONER OR FIRM role from a CLIENT role. Leg (ii) DOES NOT FIRE on this family's characteristic file. A register of members has columns for holders and dates; a register of directors has columns for officers and appointment dates; a formation packet names subscribers and incorporators. None of them carries a practitioner slot or a client slot anywhere on the page - the practitioner is invisible on the artefact they maintain. This template therefore substitutes leg (ii) with an ENTITY-REGISTRATION-NUMBER-shaped token in a LABELLED SLOT, repeated across two or more artefacts, alongside leg (i) held unchanged. The deletion test survives intact: delete every entity name and every document-type word, and the register's column structure and the repeated identifier slot are what remain.

THE REGISTER STRUCTURE, and it is the signal neither business_operations neighbour can see. A perpetually-amended columnar ledger under a heading naming the register - members, directors, secretaries, directors' residential addresses, charges, transfers, allotments, people with significant control or beneficial owners - whose COLUMN SET pairs a holder or officer identity with an ENTRY or APPOINTMENT date AND a CESSATION, TRANSFER-OUT or REMOVAL column. The paired entry/exit columns are the discriminator: a register is a running state, not an event. Read through 00's spreadsheet path - "Spreadsheets such as XLSX, XLS, CSV, TSV, ODS, and Numbers exports should yield workbook or file metadata, sheet names, column headers, visible cell values, table-like regions, formulas only when useful, and dates or identifiers from labeled cells." - and, when the register is a scanned or Word statutory book, through the table path - "Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs." A register is neither a meeting nor a submission, which is why `business_operations.board-governance` (anchor: a body and its cycle) and `business_operations.corporate-regulatory-filings` (anchor: an obligation to an authority with a deadline and a filing reference) both miss it.

THE FORMATION PACKET: two or more members co-occurring under ONE entity identifier - an incorporation application or formation form, a memorandum or certificate of incorporation, a first written consent of incorporator or first-board resolution, a share subscription or initial allotment return, a registered-office and first-officers statement, a tax or registration-number allocation notice - where AT LEAST ONE member's execution block is blank or bracketed. Purpose-coherent and content-incoherent, which is the shape 00 licenses as its own grouping reason; blank execution is what keeps it off `legal`.

THE ENTITY-INVENTORY OR GROUP-STRUCTURE structure: a schedule, workbook or chart whose ROWS OR NODES ARE LEGAL PERSONS, not humans - each with a jurisdiction of incorporation, a registration number, an incorporation date, a status token (active, dormant, in liquidation, struck off, dissolved) and an ownership percentage or share class pointing at a parent row. The row-identity test is the whole signal: rows that are people make it an HR chart, rows that are holders with amounts make it a cap table, rows that are entities make it this.

THE COMPLIANCE-CALENDAR structure: a table or calendar export whose rows pair an ENTITY identifier with a named recurring obligation and an ANNIVERSARY-derived due date - accounts reference date, confirmation or annual-return anniversary, annual general meeting window, registered-agent renewal - and which spans MORE THAN ONE entity. Recurrence keyed to an incorporation anniversary rather than to a matter start or a hearing is what separates it from `law_practice.deadlines-diary`, whose dates run off a limitation period or a listing.

A DRAFT DECISION INSTRUMENT WITH THE EXECUTION AND ATTENDANCE SLOTS DELIBERATELY OPEN: a written resolution, board minute, consent or shareholder approval whose signature line, date line and attendance or quorum line are placeholders, square-bracketed, or filled with [DATE] / [NAME] tokens, carried together with a specific entity identifier and a draft or version marker. Entity-specific but unadopted: it is not `legal` (no execution block), not `business_operations.board-governance` (no attendance, no quorum, no numbered pack - the meeting has not happened), and not `law_practice.precedent-bank` (whose party slots are blank by design across ALL entities, not filled for one).

THE ENTITY-MANAGEMENT-SYSTEM EXPORT: a structured dump - workbook, CSV, XML or PDF report - whose header block names an entity-management or corporate-registry product and whose sheets or sections are exactly the register set plus an officer list plus a filing history, with one row per entity or per register entry. The multi-register sheet set inside one file is the tell; a single-sheet officer list is not enough.

THE CORPORATE-RECORD HANDOVER SCHEDULE: an itemised list of statutory books, seals, share certificate books, original certificates of incorporation and register volumes being returned to the entity or transferred to a successor provider, with a receipt or acknowledgement line. This is the family's terminal artefact and it inherits the schema's closure-and-transfer signal, narrowed to physical and digital corporate records rather than matter papers.
needs_llm: WHICH SIDE OF THE RECORD THE HOLDER IS ON - the family's central ambiguity and the one that decides between this row and `business_operations.board-governance` / `business_operations.corporate-regulatory-filings`. The same minute, the same register page and the same confirmation statement exist in two custodies: the entity's own, and the provider's. Only reading for a matter, engagement, service or client framing settles it, and where it is absent the answer is Review Later, not a guess.

WHETHER A REGISTER PAGE IS THE MAINTAINED LEDGER OR A PURCHASED REGISTRY EXTRACT. Both list officers with dates. The maintained ledger carries entry AND cessation columns and unfilled future rows; the extract carries a registry retrieval stamp, a purchase or transaction reference, and a snapshot date. See the collision fixture.

WHETHER A CONSTITUTIONAL DOCUMENT IS A DRAFT, AN ADOPTED-BUT-UNSIGNED CONFORMED COPY, OR AN EXECUTED INSTRUMENT. The third is `legal`'s and `legal` runs first; the first is this row's; the second is genuinely contested and is a NEEDS-JOSEPH item.

WHETHER A MULTI-ENTITY SCHEDULE IS AN ENTITY INVENTORY OR A CAP TABLE. Both are workbooks of names, dates and percentages. Reading whether the rows are legal persons with jurisdictions or holders with instrument counts is a semantic judgement no filename supports.

WHETHER A NAMED NATURAL PERSON ON A REGISTER IS A PUBLIC OFFICER ENTRY OR A PROTECTED ADDRESS ENTRY. A register of directors' residential addresses and a beneficial-ownership register hold home addresses that the corresponding registry copy suppresses; the two look identical in structure and differ only in the column set.
never_alone: A COMPANY, ENTITY, TRUST OR PARTNERSHIP NAME ALONE, including its Ltd / LLC / Inc / GmbH / Pty / SA suffix, and including a registered-office address block or a letterhead footer. Read across by inference from 00's reasoning that "A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization" - the ROLE AMBIGUITY argument transfers whole, and harder: one company name appears as the holder's own employer, as the holder's client, as a counterparty, as a vendor on an invoice, as an insurer, as a landlord, and as a cited third party, sometimes in one folder. TRIPS: `ACME Holdings Ltd - Invoice 04821.pdf`, which is `finance.receipts-expenses` and shares every entity token with a real register.

A COMPANY NUMBER, REGISTRATION NUMBER, ENTITY ID, EIN, ABN, VAT OR TAX-IDENTIFIER TOKEN ALONE. It is a LINKAGE token that only acquires meaning after its own labelled role is established. It sits in the footer of every letterhead, every set of terms and conditions, every website privacy notice and every invoice produced by any company on earth - including companies this holder has never acted for. Its digits are never a date, and a bare number is struck by 00's own bare-number reasoning.

A DOCUMENT-TYPE WORD ALONE - register, minutes, minute book, resolution, consent, articles, bylaws, memorandum, constitution, shareholder, member, director, officer, company secretary, corporate governance, statutory books, registered agent. These are values and headings, not structure. The deletion test the schema inherits from `business_operations.organisational-records` applies unchanged: delete every entity name and every document-type word, and if nothing structural survives, nothing fires.

A COMPANIES-REGISTRY DOWNLOAD, A FILING STAMP, A REGISTRY WATERMARK, A CERTIFIED-COPY SEAL OR A GOOD-STANDING CERTIFICATE ALONE. This is the family's headline false positive and it is struck absolutely: anyone may buy the registry record of any company for a small fee, so a stamped extract is evidence about the REGISTRY, never evidence that the holder maintains the record, acts for the entity, or is the entity. It is equally consistent with due diligence on a counterparty, with a KYC pack, and with idle curiosity.

A PRACTITIONER NAME, A COMPANY-SECRETARY TITLE, A CHARTERED-SECRETARY OR GOVERNANCE-INSTITUTE POST-NOMINAL, OR A CORPORATE-SERVICES PROVIDER'S BRANDING ALONE. Inherited from the schema and conceded in full there: a role name says what a PERSON is and nothing about what an artefact records or which side holds it. A role name cannot carry a template any more than it can carry a schema.

AN EXECUTED SHARE CERTIFICATE, EXECUTED ARTICLES, A SIGNED SHAREHOLDERS' AGREEMENT OR A SEALED CERTIFICATE OF INCORPORATION ALONE. That is `legal`'s executed-instrument structure - a bound party pair plus an execution or notarial block - and `legal` is one of the four domains 00 orders first: "Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains, meaning the system detects and protects them before any cloud or automated placement decision is allowed." This template never displaces it.

A MISSING EXECUTION BLOCK ALONE, USED AS PROOF OF DRAFT. This is the absence trap and it is struck by name, because a row defined by the absence of something is not a row. A scanned register page has no execution block; a compliance calendar has none; an entity inventory has none. Absence is never the signal - the register structure, the entity-identifier slot and the open ATTENDANCE and DATE placeholders together are. Read against 00's own refusal to let an absence prove a kind, its missing-EXIF-as-screenshot-proof rule.

AN ANNUAL OR FINANCIAL-YEAR DATE, AN AS-AT DATE, OR AN ANNIVERSARY ALONE. Every annual report, every audit file, every insurance renewal and every payroll year-end carries one. This world is anniversary-cyclical, which makes the date the most tempting and least discriminating token it owns.

grouping_reasons: ONE ENTITY ACROSS ITS LIFE: the formation packet, the register set, the officer changes, the annual cycle and the dissolution record, joined by one exact registration-number token rather than by similar filenames. This is the family's only strong anchor and it is the reason `entity_registration_number` is proposed at all.

ONE CORPORATE ACTION AS IT TRAVELS: a board resolution draft, the resulting register entry, the share certificate and the registry notification, purpose-coherent and content-incoherent. This is the reason most likely to tempt an entity label onto a sparse file, and the reason `group_without_copying_facts` is true on most of the examples below.

ONE GROUP AT ONE MOMENT: the entity inventory, the structure chart and the multi-entity compliance calendar, joined because each row is the same set of legal persons. Legitimate as a group; NOT a licence to write a parent-entity fact onto every subsidiary's file.
ONE HANDOVER: the closure schedule, the receipt and the transferred register volumes. Terminal and purpose-coherent.

template.why: EMPTY BY CONTRACT - a dimension may only branch on a field the same schema declares, and `law_practice` declares none (D1 as narrowed, PR-6) - and empty a second time because this material co-activates `legal`, a safety domain whose protection runs first and from which no deep template unlocks. THE RECOMMENDATION HELD AS PROSE, and it differs from the `law_practice` default in a way that is structural, not cosmetic. The schema default is: client where the corpus genuinely spans more than one and the user has approved a client-named branch, then MATTER, then document function, then period last. THIS TEMPLATE INVERTS THE SECOND LEVEL: the ENTITY comes before the matter, because one engagement routinely spans fifty entities and one entity routinely outlives a dozen matters. Branching matter-first here produces precisely what 00's template validator rejects - the engine must check that a proposed template does not "create meaningless one-child levels" - because corporate secretarial work is a PERPETUAL RETAINER, not a matter with a start and an end, and a matter level under it would hold one child forever. Function follows the entity for 00's own reason, that a child is unintelligible without its parent: "A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known, and a course code may require the school or term to disambiguate it" - a register entry, an allotment return or a resolution draft is meaningless until you know WHICH legal person it constitutes. Period comes LAST but is genuinely load-bearing here, unlike in the schema default, because the world is anniversary-cyclical: the same four functions recur every year per entity. NOT time_first even so: "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders" - and a year-first corporate record would scatter one entity's incorporation from its first annual cycle. THREE PROHIBITIONS BIND THIS ROW. First, the client level is seeded ineligible as in the schema default. Second, and this is the asymmetry particular to this row and worth stating because it is easy to get backwards: the ENTITY's existence is usually public at a registry, but the fact that THIS FILESYSTEM HOLDS ITS CONSTITUTIONAL RECORD is not, and it discloses a service relationship - so an entity level is user-approved, never automatic, and public registration is not an argument for it. Third, a NAMED NATURAL PERSON from a register - a member, a beneficial owner, a director whose residential address the register carries - may NEVER be a folder level, however clean the grouping axis, against "The default posture must therefore be local-first and data-minimizing." Whatever lands stays advisory: "The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions."

collides_with.signal: RECIPROCAL AND ALREADY HALF-WRITTEN BY THE NEIGHBOUR, whose landed row states the seam in the same terms: "A practitioner running a client's company secretarial work produces exactly these documents for someone else's body. The discriminating evidence: a matter identifier, an engagement or client framing, or a time-recording or billing anchor supports law_practice.corporate-secretarial; the same minute held by the entity it is ABOUT, with no matter anchor, supports this row." This row adopts that split unchanged and adds the structural half the custody test cannot reach: the neighbour's anchor is A BODY AND ITS CYCLE - a notice, a numbered pack, attendance, quorum, a minute of a meeting that HAPPENED. This row's characteristic artefacts have no cycle at all: a register is a running state, a formation packet precedes any body, a resolution draft is a meeting that has not occurred. SAME FIXTURE, BOTH SIDES: `Written Resolution of the Sole Shareholder - [DATE] - DRAFT v3.docx`. Held by the provider with a service reference and open placeholders, it is this row's; held by the entity, signed, minuted and filed into the board's own sequence with attendance and a meeting number, it is the neighbour's. Provenance: inference.

RECIPROCAL; the neighbour writes it as "Officer appointments, registry changes and confirmation statements are the corporate-secretarial function's ordinary output, whether in-house or outsourced. The discriminating evidence is the same matter-and-engagement anchor." This row accepts that and sharpens it in the other direction: the neighbour's anchor is AN OBLIGATION TO AN AUTHORITY WITH A DEADLINE AND A FILING REFERENCE - a document whose existence is compelled from outside. The register the filing is DERIVED FROM is compelled by nobody's deadline; it is maintained continuously and would exist with no registry at all. SAME FIXTURE, BOTH SIDES: `RE_ Confirmation statement due 14 May - please approve.msg`. The approval thread and the underlying register state are this row's; the submitted statement, its filing reference and the registry acknowledgement are the neighbour's, even when the same provider produced both. Provenance: inference.

INHERITED FROM THE SCHEMA AND CONCEDED IN FULL. `legal` activates on an executed-instrument structure - a bound party pair plus an execution or notarial block - and it is one of 00's four safety domains, so its protection runs first: "Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains, meaning the system detects and protects them before any cloud or automated placement decision is allowed." Every EXECUTED constitutional instrument is therefore `legal`'s on `legal`'s own evidence: signed articles, a sealed certificate of incorporation, an executed shareholders' agreement, a signed share certificate, a stock transfer form bearing signatures. What is left to this row is the UNEXECUTED and the NON-INSTRUMENTAL: the ledger, the draft, the schedule, the calendar, the packet with blank execution. SAME FIXTURE, BOTH SIDES: `Incorporation pack - Newco 3 - 2026.zip`, whose signed certificate member is `legal`'s while its unsigned formation members are this row's - which is why the example carries `also_schema: legal` rather than a single verdict. Provenance: inference.

THE REGISTER OF MEMBERS AND THE CAP TABLE DESCRIBE THE SAME SHAREHOLDINGS AND ARE NOT THE SAME ARTEFACT. The register is the CONSTITUTIONAL record - legally determinative of membership, entry and cessation dated, no valuation - and belongs here. The cap table is the ECONOMIC model - fully diluted counts, option pools, preference stacks, round pricing, scenario tabs - and belongs to the neighbour. SAME FIXTURE, BOTH SIDES: `Group entity list - jurisdictions and status - Q1 2026.xlsx` competes with a cap table workbook on filename alone; the discriminator is the ROW IDENTITY - legal persons with jurisdictions and statuses here, holders with instrument counts and amounts there. Where one workbook genuinely carries both a members sheet and a fully-diluted sheet, that is a two-schema file, not a contest, and the safer protective reading governs. Provenance: inference.

SIBLING SEAM ON THE SAME SCHEMA, and it must be drawn or the two rows duplicate. The sibling holds a submission MADE ON A CLIENT'S BEHALF to an authority - the act of filing, its evidence and its response, across every regulator. This row holds the ENTITY RECORD the corporate filings are drawn from, and stops at the point of submission. Where a registry filing is the only artefact, the sibling has it; where the register, the resolution and the calendar are present and the filing is one member of that set, the set is this row's and the filing artefact is the sibling's. Provenance: inference.

BOTH ROWS HOLD UNEXECUTED CONSTITUTIONAL DOCUMENTS AND THE DISCRIMINATOR IS WHETHER THE ENTITY SLOTS ARE FILLED. A precedent's party, entity and date slots are BLANK BY DESIGN across all entities - that blankness is its purpose. This row's draft has ONE specific entity's name and registration number in its recitals with only the EXECUTION slots open. SAME FIXTURE, BOTH SIDES: an `Articles of Association` DOCX; with [COMPANY NAME] throughout it is the precedent bank's, with ACME Holdings Ltd (12345678) in the recitals and an unsigned execution page it is this row's. Provenance: inference.

A SHARE SALE, A REORGANISATION AND A SOLVENT LIQUIDATION ALL PRODUCE RESOLUTIONS, ALLOTMENT RETURNS AND REGISTER ENTRIES. The sibling's anchor is a bounded transaction with counterparties, a signing and a completion; this row's is the entity's continuous constitutional state, which exists before the deal and outlives it. The corporate-action documents generated INSIDE a deal are the sibling's while the deal is live; the register entries they cause are this row's permanently. Provenance: inference.

THE REFUSAL-ADJACENT NEIGHBOUR, cited because its deletion test is the one this row applies to itself. Where a corporate-shaped file survives on nothing but an entity name and a document-type word, neither this row nor that one should activate. Naming it here prevents the failure mode where a bare `Company documents/` folder is read as a corporate-secretarial corpus. Provenance: inference.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Letter of Appointment - Non-Executive Director - J. Smith.pdf`, together with the consent-to-act and the particulars-of-appointment form that accompany it. This row owns the ENTITY'S OFFICER RECORD - the appointment as an event in one legal person's constitutional state, which is why it is filed beside a register of directors and a particulars-change record joined by one registration number. `career` owns THE PERSON'S OWN WORK HISTORY - the same appointment as one line in one natural person's record, filed beside a CV, other engagement letters and other employers, joined by one PERSON across many organisations. Discriminated by THE JOIN AXIS OF THE SURROUNDING SET, never by the document: an entity identifier repeated across artefacts with different people on them is this row's; a person identifier repeated across artefacts with different entities on them is `career`'s. Corollary that matters more than the edge: a directorship listed on a CV or a professional profile is `career`'s and is NEVER an officer record, because an entity name in a career document is the collector role 00 strikes. Provenance: inference.

falls_through_to.why: The default home when this row does not confidently activate, because its characteristic isolated file is a document about NAMED THIRD PARTIES who never chose this filesystem - members, beneficial owners, directors whose residential addresses a register carries. 00 names the residual and this material together: "Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts."

The right home for this family's defining failure, which is custody: a real corporate document whose SIDE is unresolved - the entity's own record, or a provider's copy of it. "Review Later may hold files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision."

Where the collision fixture lands: a single purchased registry extract or a good-standing certificate with no surrounding corpus is a standalone durable record and nothing more. "Independent Records may live under Personal/Independent Records and hold standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group."

Common here: password-protected entity-management exports and split statutory-book archives. "Unsupported or Encrypted may hold—or, more safely, represent without moving—password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats."

sensitivity_why: Split, and the split is the point - a uniform reading is wrong in both directions. Much of this material has a public twin at a registry, which tempts a permissive default; but the register of members and any beneficial-ownership or significant-control register carry named natural persons, ownership shares and, in the residential-address registers, home addresses that the public registry copy deliberately suppresses. Board and resolution drafts carry unannounced transactions, officer removals and reserve decisions. The subjects are THIRD PARTIES who never chose this filesystem, which is the `law_practice` schema's own privacy premise, and "The default posture must therefore be local-first and data-minimizing." A registry copy of the same facts is never an argument for exposing the holder's copy: it discloses, additionally, that this filesystem holds the record.
